checks.name: pinned_versions
checks.enforces: every artifact was computed under a library version requirements.txt pins, so a reader who follows the run command gets the numbers the report carries. Violations are counted against a declared debt that names each file, and a violation in a file the declaration does not name fails whatever the total says

checks.name: headline_horizon
checks.enforces: the scoring window is declared, never spelled

checks.name: expensive_edits
checks.enforces: no expensive producer carries an edit that changes no computed figure, because such an edit costs its whole runtime and buys nothing

checks.name: build_selftest
checks.enforces: the build's own self-test passes: the graph it derives from the syntax of every script still holds one producer per artifact, no cycle and every file operation accounted for. Failing assertions are counted against a ceiling that is a declared debt and may only be lowered

checks.name: requirements_census
checks.enforces: the census inside requirements.txt still agrees with the tree it describes, read twice: once through the census's own comparison and once by reading the counts straight out of the block and asking the tree for the same ones. A finding that differs in nothing but the date the census stamps as it renders reports the calendar rather than the tree, and is counted apart

checks.name: prose_numbers
checks.enforces: every figure the register declares equals the artifact leaf at the address the register itself writes down, and the check measures its own blindness. The register belongs to the write-up and is not shipped here, so with none named (--registry PATH or PROSE_REGISTRY) the check records that it compared nothing and exits 0

checks.name: run_happened
checks.enforces: before a comparison of numbers is allowed to mean anything, the run that produced them is shown to have happened: a finish time later than the launch and a producer hash equal to the file on disk. Run here with no reference moment, so only the hash leg is judged; pass --since after a recompute to ask the other one

checks.name: notebook_expectations
checks.enforces: the figures written into the reproduction notebook are the figures its file of figures holds, and no cell fetches them from anywhere else

checks.name: notebook_pointer_table
checks.enforces: the table of figures the reproduction notebook says it cannot rebuild names none that it does rebuild, and every row of it points at a script and an address a reader can open

checks.name: contrast_hygiene
checks.enforces: the arms of every published difference differ only along the axis their declaration names, and every measurement declared to be held equal between them actually is

checks.name: join_nolookahead
checks.enforces: no join reaches forward in time

checks.name: decision_lookahead
checks.enforces: no decision is taken with data from after it: the population, the cutoff and the constant a score is compared with all come from the early half

checks.name: dir_vs_startpos
checks.enforces: trade direction agrees with the pre-trade position

checks.name: book_orientation
checks.enforces: the order book is the right way up

checks.name: closedpnl
checks.enforces: realized profit agrees with the exchange's own field (reads the ignored quickwin_markouts.npz intermediate)

checks.name: maker_attribution
checks.enforces: a fill is attributed to the maker that filled it (fetches a byte range from Zenodo)

checks.name: input_freshness
checks.enforces: every artifact still stands on the version of each input it recorded reading, which neither freshness gate above can see: both compare an artifact against its producer's hash and so ask only whether the code changed. Runs last, because it hashes the results files of the checks around it
